title: Node.js October 2026 Security Releases (Node2Shell / Brotli OOB Write & High CVEs)

CVE-2026-111497.summary: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write leading to potential remote code execution (High). Affects bundled Brotli and shared system Brotli older than upstream commit 0ed4268.

CVE-2026-106069.summary: TLS hostname verification bypass via non-canonical IP address strings (High).

CVE-2026-105483.summary: TLS hostname verification bypass via fullwidth digits on Node 24.x and 26.x (High).

affected.notes: 10 CVEs fixed in October 2026 security release (4 rated High, 3 Medium, 3 Low). EOL lines 18, 20, 23, and 25 receive no official fixes.

branches.notes: Node 25 is EOL and receives no fix.
Node 23 is EOL and receives no fix.
Node 20 is EOL and receives no fix.
Node 18 is EOL and receives no fix.
All older Node.js releases are EOL and affected.

mitigations.title: Upgrade Node.js to 22.23.4, 24.22.1, or 26.12.1 and rebuild containers
mitigations.notes: The recommended complete remediation for all 10 October 2026 Node.js CVEs.

mitigations.title: Update system Brotli library for shared-Brotli Node builds
mitigations.notes: Applies when Node.js is compiled with shared system Brotli (--shared-brotli). Ensure libbrotli includes upstream fix 0ed4268.

mitigations.title: Last resort: reject inbound Content-Encoding: br request bodies at reverse proxy
mitigations.notes: Last resort only. Covers inbound request bodies only; does not protect outbound HTTP client responses decoded by your app.

mitigations.title: Last resort: omit br from outbound HTTP client Accept-Encoding headers
mitigations.notes: Last resort, weak control. Only affects cooperative upstreams; a hostile upstream can still return Content-Encoding: br.
